ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.

17. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

22. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
